attempts.attempt_108: HGB with vendor-sensitive option microstructure masked; validation +$1,385 PF 1.353; diagnostic -$2,210 PF 0.536; failed diagnostic PnL/PF.
attempts.attempt_109: MLP ensemble with vendor-sensitive option microstructure masked; validation +$1,650 PF 1.374 but 19 strict trades; diagnostic -$1,390 PF 0.757; failed diagnostic PnL/PF and validation trade count.

microstructure_mask_robustness_search.interpretation: Masking IV/spread/size/volume/open-interest reduces cross-vendor brittleness but also removes enough historical edge that the tested candidates fail diagnostic profitability. This supports rejecting attempt107 as paper-ready and moving to a broader robust-training design rather than trying to adapter-patch confirmation-day drifts.

attempts.attempt_110: HGB with vendor-sensitive option microstructure bucketed; validation -$1,050 PF 0.734 with 18 trades; diagnostic +$60 PF 1.018 with 19 trades; failed validation PnL/PF/trade count and diagnostic PF/trade count.
attempts.attempt_111: MLP ensemble with vendor-sensitive option microstructure bucketed; validation +$1,770 PF 1.518 but 18 trades; diagnostic -$1,100 PF 0.759 with 21 trades; failed validation trade count and diagnostic PnL/PF.

microstructure_bucket_robustness_search.interpretation: Coarse bucketing/quantization preserves more option-state information than full masking, but the tested candidates still fail strict validation/diagnostic gates. This supports moving from simple transforms to robustness-aware training or action-stability selection rather than adapter-patching the June/July confirmation days.

feature_jitter_robustness_gate.finding: Attempt107 passes small +/-0.002 IV perturbation scenarios on development rows, but fails option spread and quote-size jitter scenarios through selected-contract instability and material PnL drift.
feature_jitter_robustness_gate.repair_implication: The next fair-contract candidate family should explicitly reward action/contract stability under realistic option spread/size perturbations on development data. Do not adapter-patch June/July confirmation days into agreement.

attempts.attempt_112: HGB raw fair-contract features with 5-point top-vs-runner-up score margin and feature-jitter gate; validation -$1,615 PF 0.718; diagnostic -$1,850 PF 0.671; jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_113: HGB raw fair-contract features with 10-point top-vs-runner-up score margin and feature-jitter gate; validation -$1,575 PF 0.755; diagnostic -$2,680 PF 0.541; jitter gate failed.

score_margin_jitter_gated_search.interpretation: A hard score-margin filter is not sufficient. It worsens strict historical replay and still fails option spread/size/IV jitter robustness, so the next repair should make robustness part of training or candidate scoring rather than a post-hoc selection filter.

attempts.attempt_114: HGB trained with fit-only vendor_microstructure_jitter_v1; validation +$2,770 PF 1.500; diagnostic -$3,300 PF 0.497; jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_115: MLP ensemble trained with fit-only vendor_microstructure_jitter_v1; validation +$840 PF 1.180 with 18 trades; diagnostic -$1,670 PF 0.707; jitter gate failed.

feature_noise_augmentation_search.interpretation: Naive fit-only feature-noise augmentation did not produce a paper-ready fair-contract model. It suggests the current narrow put/VWAP pocket and label/model family remain unstable under the fair game, so the next repair should use a broader stability-aware objective rather than more simple microstructure transforms.

attempts.attempt_116: HGB with jitter_stability_stressed threshold selection; validation +$1,630 PF 1.304; diagnostic -$2,420 PF 0.581; jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_117: MLP ensemble with jitter_stability_stressed threshold selection; validation +$1,160 PF 1.352 with 16 trades; diagnostic -$890 PF 0.804; jitter gate failed.

jitter_stressed_threshold_search.interpretation: Jitter-aware threshold selection improved the shape of some failures but still did not produce a paper-ready candidate. Threshold mechanics on the current narrow put/VWAP pocket are not sufficient; the next repair should broaden entry filters, labels, or candidate objectives while keeping the jitter-stressed gate.

attempts.attempt_118: HGB with put_near_10_20_offset and jitter_stability_stressed threshold selection; validation +$60 PF 1.012; diagnostic -$2,240 PF 0.719; jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_119: Right-specialized HGB with near_10_20_offset and jitter_stability_stressed threshold selection; validation -$6,140 PF 0.097; diagnostic -$1,510 PF 0.750; jitter gate failed.

broader_entry_filter_jitter_gated_search.interpretation: Broader entry filters did not recover fair-contract edge. They added exposure without stable validation/diagnostic profitability and still failed jitter stability.

two_stage_selector_diagnostic.interpretation: The causal live-v1 rows still contain stable candidate-level opportunity, but the highest-average OMAR/range gate is too sparse by itself. Trade-sufficient gates justify learned-model attempts but do not themselves prove paper readiness because the diagnostic uses labels as an oracle.

attempts.attempt_120: HGB with put_near_after_0940_vwap_m2_10_omar_neg; validation +$5,850 PF 2.851; diagnostic -$1,980 PF 0.490; jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_121: HGB with put_near_after_0940_vwap_m2_10_range_20_45; validation +$2,390 PF 1.616; diagnostic -$250 PF 0.926; jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_122: HGB with put_near_after_0940_vwap_m2_10_near_vwap; validation +$5,650 PF 2.859; diagnostic +$605 PF 1.110 with 24 trades; strict replay failed diagnostic PF and jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_123: HGB with put_near_after_0940_vwap_m2_10_premium_gte_7_5; validation +$4,220 PF 1.783; diagnostic -$930 PF 0.849; jitter gate failed.

compound_selector_jitter_gated_search.interpretation: Compound first-stage context gates improve the search evidence but do not solve paper readiness. The near-VWAP branch nearly survives strict replay but still fails diagnostic PF and remains selected-contract/PnL fragile under spread and quote-size perturbations. The next repair should target ranking stability or aggregate candidate selection, not more narrow hand filters.

attempts.attempt_124: HGB near-VWAP branch with deterministic stable_abs_offset_10 contract selection; validation +$7,555 PF 4.522; diagnostic +$270 PF 1.058; strict replay failed diagnostic PF and feature-jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_125: HGB near-VWAP branch with deterministic stable_abs_offset_15 contract selection; validation +$6,615 PF 4.454; diagnostic +$35 PF 1.008; strict replay failed diagnostic PF and feature-jitter gate failed.
attempts.attempt_126: HGB near-VWAP branch with deterministic stable_abs_offset_20 contract selection; validation +$4,925 PF 3.397; diagnostic +$555 PF 1.130; candidate validation passed but strict replay still failed diagnostic PF and feature-jitter gate failed.

stable_selection_jitter_gated_search.interpretation: Deterministic fixed-offset contract selection reduces one form of score-ranking freedom but does not produce a paper-ready model. The attempts keep strong validation PnL while diagnostic PF collapses below the required 1.25 and option spread/size jitter still changes selected contracts or PnL materially. The next repair should move from per-contract top-score selection to a decision-level or aggregate candidate-value objective that can decide whether the minute is tradable without depending on brittle contract-ranking details.

attempts.attempt_127: HGB decision_best_profit_regression with stable_abs_offset_15; validation +$3,100 PF 1.695 with 23 trades; diagnostic -$2,140 PF 0.620 with 24 trades; strict replay failed but feature-jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_128: HGB decision_best_profit_regression with stable_abs_offset_20; validation +$3,690 PF 1.893 with 25 trades; diagnostic -$2,000 PF 0.610 with 24 trades; strict replay failed but feature-jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_129: HGB decision_profit_presence_classifier with stable_abs_offset_15; validation +$4,280 PF 3.365 with 18 trades; diagnostic +$120 PF 1.043 with 17 trades; strict replay failed but feature-jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_130: HGB decision_profit_presence_classifier with stable_abs_offset_20; validation +$4,760 PF 3.850 with 20 trades; diagnostic +$50 PF 1.020 with 17 trades; strict replay failed but feature-jitter gate passed.

aggregate_decision_objective_search.interpretation: Aggregate decision-level targets are the first tested repair family to pass the option-feature jitter gate across every attempt. This supports the diagnosis that per-contract ranking was the vendor-sensitive component. However, the tested near-VWAP aggregate variants still fail strict replay through weak diagnostic PF/trade count, so the next repair should preserve the aggregate/stable-selection structure while broadening or reshaping the opportunity filter/target to recover diagnostic edge.

attempts.attempt_131: HGB decision_profit_presence_classifier with broader put_near_after_0940_vwap_m2_10 filter and stable_abs_offset_20; validation +$1,970 PF 1.540 with 21 trades; diagnostic -$330 PF 0.925 with 22 trades; strict replay failed but feature-jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_132: HGB decision_profit_presence_classifier with premium>=7.5 gate and stable_abs_offset_20; validation +$1,970 PF 1.540 with 21 trades; diagnostic -$330 PF 0.925 with 22 trades; strict replay failed but feature-jitter gate passed.

broader_aggregate_decision_objective_sea.interpretation: Broadening the aggregate/stable classifier confirms that the new structure is much less sensitive to option-feature jitter, but the broader filters lose diagnostic edge. The remaining blocker is no longer primarily vendor microstructure fragility; it is finding a causal target/filter/lifecycle combination with enough out-of-sample diagnostic expectancy under the fair game.

aggregate_edge_loss_diagnostic.finding: Aggregate/stable attempts pass option-feature jitter but fail diagnostic expectancy. The largest diagnostic loser bucket for attempt130 is positive 15-minute momentum on put entries; however, follow-up causal filters that removed or side-switched this bucket did not recover strict diagnostic edge.
aggregate_edge_loss_diagnostic.repair_implication: The next repair should stop adding narrow context filters and inspect whether the current entry labels/lifecycle policy are mispricing continuation and reversals under the fair contract.

attempts.attempt_133: Aggregate classifier with non-positive momentum put filter; validation +$3,430 PF 2.429 with 21 trades; diagnostic -$460 PF 0.859 with 13 trades; jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_134: Aggregate classifier with positive OMAR plus non-positive momentum put filter; validation +$1,630 PF 1.668 with 15 trades; diagnostic -$150 PF 0.947 with 11 trades; jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_135: Aggregate classifier with premium>=7.5 plus non-positive momentum put filter; validation +$2,730 PF 1.881 with 21 trades; diagnostic -$180 PF 0.945 with 13 trades; jitter gate passed.

momentum_filtered_aggregate_search.interpretation: Removing the diagnostic positive-momentum loser bucket preserves jitter robustness but starves/reduces diagnostic edge and trade count. The aggregate/stable structure is robust, but narrow momentum filters are not sufficient.

attempts.attempt_136: Aggregate classifier with positive-momentum calls and non-positive-momentum puts; validation +$3,050 PF 1.753 with 22 trades; diagnostic -$2,700 PF 0.636 with 23 trades; jitter gate passed.
attempts.attempt_137: Same side-aware filter with premium>=7.5; validation +$3,050 PF 1.753 with 22 trades; diagnostic -$2,700 PF 0.636 with 23 trades; jitter gate passed.

side_aware_aggregate_search.interpretation: Side-switching on momentum does not solve the edge loss and materially worsens diagnostic performance. The remaining problem is likely not a simple side filter; it points toward entry-label/lifecycle/exit objective design under the fair contract.

option_feature_pair_attribution.finding: Cross-vendor drift at the actionable timestamps is concentrated in option-side features, not market context. July 1 action drift is driven by a tiny IV difference crossing the max_score_ceiling guard; July 2 selected-contract drift is driven by spread/size differences among close put scores.
option_feature_pair_attribution.repair_implication: Do not paper-submit attempt107 as-is. Either reject this score-ceiling/tree candidate as too data-plane-sensitive or run a new fair-contract search that explicitly avoids brittle option-IV/spread/size threshold dependence using only development data.
